params.caption: 🖥️ TSMC confirms employee data leak, reportedly sold for 3 bitcoin The world's biggest chipmaker, which builds processors and GPUs for AMD, NVIDIA and Apple, says employee data was "made available on an external website without authorization." Reports claim the information was listed for sale on shady forums for three bitcoin. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 18:48 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 😬 React if this worries you · 💬 Could leaks like this hit chip supply? #TSMC #DataLeak #Semiconductors #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
